name: R039-overheat-spatk-min-weezing-memento
why: The opponent's Weezing (set 501: Memento, Sludge Bomb, Facade, Destiny Bond) leads. The player's Granbull (set 474) uses Overheat every turn: White Herb undoes the first drop, so after four Overheats its Sp. Atk is at -6. Granbull is weak (Sp. Atk 60, no STAB) so Weezing (Sitrus Berry) usually survives the four hits; on the fifth turn the AI's bad-move check scores Memento against a target at minimum Sp. Atk (AI_CBM_Memento, data/battle_ai_scripts.s:483-484, -8). Lost if Weezing uses Memento or Destiny Bond earlier or faints.

onHold.result: no hit in lab seeds 90000..90079 (box hunt rrh1), no engine error. In seed 90079 the player Granbull (157 HP) is knocked out by Weezing in three turns (157 -> 77 -> 22 -> 0), so its Sp. Atk never reaches -6 and the AI never scores Memento against it. The design needs a sturdier Overheat user.
